title: Hermes X-Hermes-Session-Key
description: Schema for Hermes v0.13 X-Hermes-Session-Key. Raw key is never logged and key is scoped to subject.

session_key_hash.description: Hashed representation of the session key. Raw key is never stored.

hash_algorithm.description: Algorithm used to hash the session key.

subject_id.description: Required. Subject ID to scope the session key.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when session key was created.

last_rotated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when session key was last rotated.

rotation_count.description: Number of times the session key has been rotated.

key_scope_resolvable.description: Whether the key scope can be resolved without subject context.

audit_event_on_rotation.description: Whether rotation creates an audit event.
